t=df['t'].values; x=df['x'].values; v=df['v'].values; y=df['dv_dt'].values
def fit(extra, ks=np.linspace(1.6,2.0,401)):
    best=None
    for k in ks:
        A=np.column_stack([t*np.log(t), np.sin(k*v)*np.sqrt(x)]+extra)
        c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,y,rcond=None); e=np.mean((A@c-y)**2)/np.var(y)
        if best is None or e<best[0]: best=(e,k,np.round(c,5))
    return best
print('sqrt v + 1', fit([np.sqrt(v), np.ones_like(t)]))
print('sqrt v only', fit([np.sqrt(v)]))
print('sqrt v + x', fit([np.sqrt(v), x]))
print('sqrt v + v', fit([np.sqrt(v), v]))
print('sqrt v + 1 + v', fit([np.sqrt(v), np.ones_like(t), v]))
print('sqrt v*x', fit([np.sqrt(v)*x]))
print('sqrt v*t', fit([np.sqrt(v)*t]))
print('sqrt v + 1 + x', fit([np.sqrt(v), np.ones_like(t), x]))
